description: Transcript Costs 2 credits. Empty results and failures are never charged. Pass cache=true for a free 24h cache hit (default always fresh).

cache.description: Serve from the 24h shared cache when available (0 credits on hit). Default true — set false to always fetch fresh.

language.description: Preferred caption language as an ISO code, e.g. "en". Defaults to auto-detect.

url.description: Public TikTok video URL, e.g. https://tiktok.com/@user/video/ID. Not a YouTube/Instagram/Facebook URL. The URL platform must match this endpoint's platform. Do not pass cross-platform URLs, e.g. YouTube to TikTok, Instagram to Facebook, LinkedIn to X/Twitter, or Pinterest to Rumble.

name: tiktok_transcript
title: TikTok Transcript
